layers.description: Fronting — 95% ceded to captive, 5% retained by fronter; 6% fronting fee on premium.
Captive absorbing the fronted cession. ~95% trapped (reserves + collateral + UPR); ~5% free for redeployment.
Quota Share — 50% of every policy ceded.
Working XS layer — $40M xs $20M, 1 reinstatement (100% at 100%); $80M initial capacity.
Cat XS layer — $60M xs $60M, 2 reinstatements (100% at 100%); $180M initial capacity.
Cat-bond — $80M xs $120M, indemnity trigger, 8.5% coupon, 3yr term, annual reset.
